title: finding(layout): the mobile tab bar (`bottom_nav`) draws entries the sidebar hides — `visible: false`, denied `requiredPermissions` — and an `action` entry as a dead link
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect, class (a). `reach:` the published export `AppSchemaRenderer` (`@object-ui/layout`), registered as the SDUI node `app-schema-renderer`, with `mobileNavMode: 'bottom_nav'`. Measured by rendering it at objectui `main` `2124d04111` and at PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11359's head `6f5ff7bf0a`. Reader: triage first (grade and route). Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_0122Knsowci76D2rBWReCzzZ`) from objectui#11211's dev report (`5927597493`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`), judged fileable by PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11359's contract review. ⛔ Not graded here.

Dedup: among the 600 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs (read through REST on 2026-10-01 and grepped locally), `MobileBottomNav`, `mobileNavMode`, `bottom_nav` and "mobile tab bar" match only objectui#11211 and its PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11359 (the href half of the same divergence, not this one) and closed nav work (objectui#11196, PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11207, PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11186).

## Measured

`AppSchemaRenderer` with `mobileNavMode: 'bottom_nav'`, `basePath: '/apps/crm'` and a `checkPermission` that answers `false`:

| navigation entry | mobile tab bar | sidebar (`NavigationRenderer`) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `visible: false` | **drawn** as a tab (`/apps/crm/secret`) | hidden |
| `requiredPermissions` the caller lacks | **drawn** as a tab (`/apps/crm/secret2`) | hidden |
| `type: 'action'` | **drawn** as a link to `/`, a dead tab | a button that calls `onAction`, or hidden when there is no `onAction` |
| a plain `object` entry (control) | drawn | drawn |

So on the bottom bar an author's visibility rule and permission gate do nothing, and an action entry turns into a link to the root.

## The cause (read at source, `main` `2124d04111`)

- `packages/layout/src/AppSchemaRenderer.tsx` `MobileBottomNav`, its `collectLeaves` (about `:283`–`:295`), flattens groups and skips separators, then slices to five. It applies no entry guard.
- The sidebar runs every entry through `passesNavItemGuards` (`packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx` about `:543`, used at about `:596` and `:1269`): `visible`, `requiredPermissions`, and the action handling.
- PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11359 moves the bar's hrefs and active state onto the sidebar's own `resolveHref` / `resolveActiveNavItem`. This card is the remaining half of "the bar answers differently from the sidebar": which entries are drawn at all.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- `collectLeaves` keeps only entries that `passesNavItemGuards` keeps, with the same `checkPermission` and expression context the sidebar is given. The five-tab cap applies after the guard, so a hidden entry does not take a slot. ⛔ No second copy of the guard.
- An `action` entry: drawn as the sidebar draws it (a button calling `onAction`) or left off the bar. That choice is triage's.
- **Pins:** the table's three rows through the real component, each with an ablation, plus the control row.
- Severity note: these are UI visibility gates, not data access. A drawn tab still hits the server's own checks.

Dedupe words: `MobileBottomNav visible requiredPermissions` · `bottom_nav gated entry tab` · `mobile tab bar action entry dead link` · `AppSchemaRenderer bottom nav guard`
